items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: him and a little guy by the name of George Washington used to play Trombone with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he'd never catch them fool out with them high notes. Oh, he stayed right in there. Kinda make some hominies, too. I mean, I'm gonna live, him and a little guy by the name of George Washington used to play Trombone with him.
I've heard of him, yeah, I never knew him.
